stages.title: Pilot admission and fail-closed ledger
notes: Complete cost chain: partial usage makes costOf undefined; settle charges the bound, keeps unknown and refuses further sends. Only a B-owned sender module is imported (reservation identity echoed); E never spawns a descriptor command. 66 checks, refusal sends 0.

stages.title: Eight-case three-arm bounded pilot
notes: Real execute chain is implemented but BLOCKED on adapter_missing; B-owned entry, no CLI fallback, no sample replacement.

stages.title: Proposal HTTP, attention, decisions and review timing
notes: E3-PROPOSAL-HTTP and E3-PROPOSAL-UI cover explicit proposal flows. E3-CONTEXT-PREVIEW now runs against real HTTP: bounded budget with clamping, untrusted trust label, work/contract sources, no execution effect, TTL, cross-project/foreign-conversation/missing-work/invalid-budget refusals. E2-EVIDENCE-HISTORY covers window/limit/cursor. E5-CONTEXT-USE stays NOT_TESTED because only preview and the binding schema exist, not a send/audit path.

stages.title: Explicit baseline/target installation and upgrade
notes: Install matrix is parameterized by the real tar/sha/source/build/schema tuple (no fixed schema13/ports). E3-PERSONAL-COLD-START proves personal first-run, doctor, workbench assets, bearer refusal, DB schema and stop; a different config release is refused as release_source_conflict. Managed upgrade/rollback keeps data, tampered target is refused, and a cross-schema old binary refuses with state_schema_newer_than_binary after pointer rollback. E4-MULTI-STATE records a real D defect: a stop for state A returned STOPPED and killed shared-install state B's API; the launcher-dead window is therefore NOT_TESTED. Crash windows remain E4-UPGRADE-FAULTS NOT_TESTED.

stages.title: Recovery authorization windows and bounded stability
notes: Recovery inspect/prepare replay, restart drift and no-write are verified; commit/activation and the interruption windows remain NOT_TESTED until main publishes them. Bounded cycles only.

stages.title: Layered conclusions and handoff
notes: wave10-status separates test source, product source/build and the exact artifact tuple with commands, exit codes, PASS/FAIL/NOT_TESTED and owners; wave09 and older ledgers are preserved and pilot value never gates product or install.
